text.p: Benguet Corp said Wednesday it had signed a memorandum of understanding with Petrofields Exploration & Development Co Inc for a real estate development project covering its properties in Cal Horr, Itogon, Benguet Province.
Under the terms of the deal, the company said it would provide the land, while Petrofields would make a capital investment of up to 500 million Philippine pesos.
Both companies would have a 50-percent interest in the project, it said.
Petrofields will receive 70 percent of the revenues until it recovers its initial investment in the project plus a return on investment of 400 million pesos, Benguet said.
Once it has obtained that amount, its share of the revenues will return to 50 percent, it added.

Petrofields will also grant Benguet the right to purchase 16 billion shares of its stock, 40 percent of which is exerciseable within three years from the signing of the memorandum of understanding and 60 percent within three years from the execution of the project.
Benguet Corp is a mining company in the Philippines, while Petrofields is an oil exploration company.
